decisions.reason: The maintenance oil remains tightly tied to the firm's installed base and aftercare offer, and another year of market presence strengthens sunk-cost and justification pressures to continue unless results clearly collapse.
This care line sits squarely in the firm's core maintenance strategy for oiled floors, so management is likely to interpret any mixed performance as temporary and stay committed.

The moisture-protection underlay supports the firm's system-selling logic and complements floor sales, but as a more peripheral accessory it is still somewhat easier to cut than the core floor and care lines.

The oak parquet line is closest to the firm's central business and likely embodies the greatest visible commercial and portfolio commitment, making management especially prone to defend and retain it.
